en: Colorized vintage postcard view of a large Gothic cathedral dominating a landscaped park and square. The church has prominent pointed arches, stained-glass windows, and multiple towers and spires, with surrounding historic multi‑story townhouses. A central monument or statue stands in front of the cathedral within a circular flowerbed. The sky is tinted blue and pink, typical of early color postcards. Hungarian text is printed at the top.
